__comment: Aging Cellar — deep underground workshop for barrel-conditioning premium drinks.
TEMPERATURE REQUIREMENT (see docs/30_simulation_systems/34_temperature.md):
The aging cellar block must be placed inside a *sealed room* whose computed
temperature falls within the recipe's temp_range_c. Temperature is determined
by the room's mean floor Y plus any heat bonus from torches or braziers placed
inside the sealed room.
progress_pauses_out_of_range: true
→ When the room's temperature falls outside a recipe's temp_range_c, that
recipe's aging progress bar PAUSES. Progress is not lost. Aging resumes
automatically once temperature is restored to the valid range.
→ This applies even mid-batch. A torch removed from the room during aging
may drop temperature below the minimum; the batch pauses until a torch
is replaced.
No cooling mechanic exists. If a room is too warm for a recipe, the player
must build a new aging cellar at greater depth.
If a room is too cold, placing torches inside the sealed room raises its
temperature. See 34_temperature.md for the heat_units formula.
PLACEMENT:
The aging cellar block may be placed at any Y, but its recipes will only
be available if the sealed room's computed temperature is within range.
There is no hard placement constraint on Y — temperature is the gating factor.
AGING PROCESS (two-phase, passive):
1. LOAD  — A dwarf hauls inputs to the cellar and spends work_time loading.
2. AGE   — The cellar ages autonomously for aging_time in-game hours.
No dwarf needed. Progress bar visible in workshop UI.
Progress pauses if room temperature leaves temp_range_c.
3. COLLECT — When aging_time elapses (accumulated while in-range), a COLLECT
task auto-queues. A dwarf retrieves the output to a stockpile.
Only one batch per cellar block may be in progress at a time.
Build multiple aging cellar blocks for parallel production.
RECIPE TEMPERATURE RANGES (cold mountain gradient — see 34_temperature.md):
Vintage Wine  : 6–10°C  → Cool Cave zone   (Y 57–75 baseline)
Aged Stout    : 3–7°C   → Cold Cave zone   (Y 47–64 baseline)
Reserve Gin   : 1–4°C   → Deep Cold zone   (Y 37–56 baseline)
Frozen Vault  : ≤ 0°C   → Y ≤ 35 baseline — too cold for all aging
(Torches can raise base depth temp into range — see 34_temperature.md)

Temperature out of range for wine — adjust heat sources or depth.
